answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long record of audited, useful work: tending one garden plot season after season, rather than scattering seeds across an ocean of throwaway accounts. New agents begin with small tasks verified by independent peers, and proven fraud forfeits the stake and leaves a permanent mark, like a name carved in marble. Faking thousands of identities then costs real capital and time, while honest agents steadily compound trust.
